card.name: Bwiti Dance
card.era: Ancient (Babongo origins; Fang syncretic form early 20th c.)
card.tagline: Sacred trance dance of Gabon's iboga religion
card.profile: Bwiti is a spiritual discipline and one of Gabon's officially recognized religions, practised by the forest-dwelling Babongo, Mitsogo and Fang peoples; music and dance are central to its ceremonies (Wikipedia). Practitioners consume the psychoactive root bark of the Tabernanthe iboga plant in initiation rites, rites of passage and healing ceremonies. Dance, chanting and ritual music - drums, shakers, and the ngombi (sacred harp) or musical bow - accompany all-night ceremonies through which participants reach trance and spiritual connection with ancestors. The N'ganga (ritual leader) and participants typically wear red, black and white cloth, raffia skirts and faces painted with white kaolin (Wikipedia; Kanaga Africa Tours).
card.insight: This is a sacred, religious context, not entertainment: the dance is inseparable from the iboga sacrament and ancestor veneration, and Bwiti is one of Gabon's three official religions (Wikipedia). The tradition is largely oral and many rites are deliberately kept secret.

observation.setting: Outdoor village courtyard or open-air structure at dusk/night, illuminated by candles and a fire, with seated spectators lining the perimeter.
observation.dancers: Solo male dancer performing in the center, with occasional other male dancers entering.
observation.formation_and_space: Soloist moving in an open circle/clearing in front of seated spectators.
observation.posture: Torso upright or leaning forward slightly with a low, bent-knee stance and flexed hips.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic high-stepping, stamping, and shuffling steps on beat, with ankle rattles.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms active, holding a flaming torch in one hand and leafy branches or rattle in the other.
observation.hips_and_torso: Bending and bouncing from the knees and hips with slight upper body articulation.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low to mid-level crouching, leaping over logs, and sudden drops to kneeling.
observation.costume_and_props: Bare-chested male dancer wearing grass skirts or fringe, body paint, headband, anklets/rattles, holding a flaming torch and foliage/sticks.
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement due to ground smoke and lighting conditions
